title: What is your workflow for creating 3D assets for your games?
author: jferments
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I've been seeing lots of awesome video games that you all have been developing here, and I am currently working on a hobby project myself (a game inspired by Project Zomboid and other "zombie apocalypse simulator" games).

I currently have a terrain generator, map system, etc and am now getting to the point where I want to start putting assets like plants, buildings, NPCs, etc. into my game and I need to start creating some 3D assets.

I was curious to hear about the different workflows people are using to generate 3D assets for their games.

I am familiar with ComfyUI for image/video generation, and I have dabbled a bit in Blender, so I was thinking roughly of some sort of ComfyUI generation of the draft 3d models --> Blender for finishing work. I have been looking into models like HunYuan3D and Pixal3D, but am curious what you all are using.

If you are going the ComfyUI route, what sorts of base models are you using for generation? How are you maintaining character consistency? How do you automate your Blender workflows to minimize manual editing?

Thanks!

comments.author: lexura
comments.body:
I use a mix between comfyui with krea2, blender with mcp and hunyuan3d plugin and image-gpt 2.5 - results are pretty good so far!

https://preview.redd.it/1d45znue2xsh1.jpeg?width=999&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=bb03bcb4e0cebdd5f5f13da363ec80e859d63066

replies.author: jferments
replies.body: Thanks! So as far as ComfyUI, you are mostly just using it to generate reference images and then running those through HunYuan in Blender?

replies.author: Blackspyder99
replies.body: Trellis.2 and Pixal3D do this and are native in ComfyUI

replies.author: lexura
replies.body:
Yes, I use krea2 if I want free generations, but to be honest if I have tokens left on my openai sub I'd just churn through those with image 2.5.. it's much better. my agent also uses [https://github.com/lidge-ai/ima2-gen](https://github.com/lidge-ai/ima2-gen) for prompting to keep stuff consistent. what I've found is that if I only generated the 3D with HY and tried to add the texture externally it looked shit

https://preview.redd.it/t5uqibbid0th1.png?width=517&format=png&auto=webp&s=83c6e7f34b4003f5066a59df7a2888a84d104c88

and letting HY do the full workflow it achieved better results...

replies.author: lexura
replies.body: It's actually integrated in my game and works well

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: Honestly, these are very kawaii and I love Japanese styled games. I wish I can get to see a few screenshots about your game.

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body: I wrote up like a 5 paragraph post detailing my process. But in reality it's: Concept (usually hand edited) -> Tripo -> Take pieces from different tripo meshes that I liked and seam them together manually, then retop as needed, as well as a slew of other hand work like vertex painting, highlight/shadow map making, proxy mask making for SDF gen, region assignment, etc. -> Rig if necessary (Faceit and AutoRig Pro), assign behaviours if props and not characters which is generally the 'rigging' those get since they usually animate by parts and not by organic animations) -> Usually get AI to import into the game  following a previously established framework. -> Test and possibly return to previous steps to fix something that's wrong.

Disclaimer I made it; but feel free to send me a DM and I will give you more credits and unlock 2.0 where game assets shine

Just this week I improved game assets a lot. It supports rigging now and even experimental animations. You would just say “make me a zombie in T pose with 8k polygons, rig it and add walking animation”

I would appreciate any feedback because I had barely anyone testing it

comments.author: Nilo_Team
comments.body:
for plants/buildings/npc meshes without living in blender the whole time-

nilo.io is free in the browser (monthly bits)- gen from text or a ref image, tweak model settings + LOD if you need lower polys, export GLB/FBX and drop into your engine. auto-rig works on bipedal T-pose if you need that for characters

LMK :)
